campuses.title: Uxbridge Campus
campuses.text: 177 акров (72 га) green campus, все факультеты на территории. Metropolitan Line до Baker Street.

paragraphs: Brunel University of London is a public research university in Uxbridge, West London — 18 miles from central London on the Metropolitan Line. Founded in 1966 and named after engineer Isambard Kingdom Brunel, the university is best known for engineering, design, business, sport sciences, and creative writing. Brunel is ranked in the world's top 350 (QS 2024).

International students enter via Brunel University London Pathway College — Navitas's pathway college on the Uxbridge campus. International Foundation Year, Pre-Master, and English-language programs lead into Brunel Bachelor's and Master's degrees.
paragraphsRu: Brunel University of London — государственный исследовательский университет в Аксбридже, Западный Лондон, 30 км от центра Лондона по Metropolitan Line. Основан в 1966, назван в честь инженера Isambard Kingdom Brunel. Известен инженерией, дизайном, бизнесом, sport sciences и creative writing. Топ-350 мира (QS 2024).

Международные студенты заходят через Brunel University London Pathway College — pathway-колледж Navitas на кампусе Uxbridge. International Foundation Year, Pre-Master и English-language программы ведут в бакалавриат / магистратуру Brunel.
